highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.148.0 is the first stable v4 release, built on Skia m148, with variable fonts and animated WebP.
highlights_body: This release lands variable font and color font palette support, animated WebP encoding, and a zero-copy stream helper. The singleton and typeface lifetime has been reworked throughout. This is a breaking release from 3.x — review the changes below before upgrading.

breaking.title: new SKFont() typeface is now empty
breaking.body: Skia m132 removed lazy default-typeface resolution. new SKFont() now stores SKTypeface.Empty (0 glyphs), so MeasureText returns 0 and nothing is drawn. Migration: construct with an explicit typeface — new SKFont(SKTypeface.Default). Detect 'no typeface set' with font.Typeface.IsEmpty instead of font.Typeface == null.

breaking.title: new SKPaint().Typeface is non-null by default
breaking.body: Previously null (lazy default), SKPaint.Typeface is now SKTypeface.Default on construction. Text still works out of the box. The observable break is paint.Typeface == null guards — replace with paint.Typeface.IsEmpty or remove the null check entirely.

breaking.title: SKTypeface.FromFamilyName returns Default instead of null on Android
breaking.body: Android used to return null for an unknown font family; all platforms now return SKTypeface.Default. For a strict null-on-no-match result, use SKFontManager.Default.MatchFamily(name) instead.

breaking.title: SKStream.Move(long) now throws OverflowException and is obsolete
breaking.body: The native offset is 32-bit. The Move(long) overload now uses a checked cast, so out-of-range values throw OverflowException; the method is also marked [Obsolete]. Migration: call Move(int) after validating or clamping the value.

breaking.title: GRContext.CreateVulkan aborts the process on Vulkan 1.0
breaking.body: Ganesh now requires Vulkan 1.1. With a Vulkan 1.0 instance or GRVkBackendContext.MaxAPIVersion left at 0, Skia calls SK_ABORT and the process terminates — this is not a catchable exception. Migration: create your VkInstance with VK_API_VERSION_1_1 and set MaxAPIVersion = VK_API_VERSION_1_1 on the backend context.

breaking.title: GRVkBackendContextNative — five interop fields removed
breaking.body: fMinAPIVersion, fInstanceVersion, fExtensions, fFeatures, and fOwnsInstanceAndDevice were removed. Migration: delete those assignments; use fVkExtensions in place of fExtensions and fDeviceFeatures/fDeviceFeatures2 in place of fFeatures.

breaking.title: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo retype and equality operators removed
breaking.body: GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo changed from GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo to GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo. GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo lost IEquatable<T> and the == / != operators. Update any direct struct comparisons in Vulkan Ycbcr code.

breaking.title: Pre-v4 obsolete APIs are now compile errors
breaking.body: SKPaint's legacy text/font state members (TextSize, Typeface on paint, etc.) and remaining pre-v4 obsoletes are now errors. Obsolete enums were trimmed from the ref assembly. Migration: move font configuration to SKFont; consult the v3-to-v4 migration guide.

breaking.title: SKNativeObject.IgnorePublicDispose setter removed
breaking.body: The protected set; accessor on IgnorePublicDispose was removed. Custom SKNativeObject subclasses that assigned the property must remove those assignments — the property is now read-only.

bullets.detail: The bundled Skia engine was upgraded through milestones m132, m133, m147, and m148, incorporating upstream bug fixes and stability improvements across all rendering paths.

bullets.lead: Variable font and color font palette support
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp now expose variable font axis manipulation and color font palette enumeration. Use SKTypeface to query and set axis values; color palettes are accessible via the new palette APIs.
New SKWebpEncoder APIs let you encode animated WebP files directly from a sequence of frames, complementing the existing animated WebP decoding support.
SKStream.GetData() exposes the underlying buffer without copying when the stream owns its memory, useful for pipeline steps that hand off encoded data.
SKSurface.Draw and SKCanvas.DrawSurface now accept an SKSamplingOptions parameter, giving callers explicit control over resampling quality when compositing surfaces.

bullets.lead: HBColor struct and additional HarfBuzz wrappers
bullets.detail: The new HBColor struct correctly represents hb_color_t (BGRA byte-order). Missing HarfBuzz API wrappers were added and naming-convention violations across the binding were corrected.

bullets.lead: SKPixmap and SKBitmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset corrected
bullets.detail: GetPixelSpan now uses RowBytes for stride (not Width × bytesPerPixel), and the per-pixel GetPixelSpan<T>(x,y) offset calculation no longer uses Height where Width is required.
When the GC collected an SKPathBuilder before its associated SKPath, the SKPath finalizer would access freed memory. The ordering is now safe.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found on .NET 9
bullets.detail: SkiaSharp.Views.WinUI consumers on .NET 9 could fail to load the projection DLL. The asset resolution was corrected.

bullets.lead: Android SKGLView blank after tab switch
bullets.detail: SKGLView stopped rendering after switching away and back in a MAUI TabBar on Android. The GL context is now correctly restored.

The global singleton objects (SKColorSpace.Srgb, SKFontManager.Default, etc.) are now managed through a deterministic registry that tracks handle equality and ref-counts correctly, eliminating double-dispose and stale-handle races.

The version-compatibility check that guards native entry points was moved from [ModuleInitializer] (which runs at assembly load) to the SkiaApi static constructor, avoiding load-order surprises in trimmed and AOT builds.
Pre-built native binaries for Linux Bionic (Android-derived userspace) are now included in the NuGet packages, enabling SkiaSharp on Bionic-based Linux environments.

bullets.lead: Tizen x64 and arm64 native builds
bullets.detail: Tizen gains x64 and arm64 CI build support, bringing it in line with the existing armel coverage.
Library TFMs now use the versioned forms (ios26.0, maccatalyst26.0, etc.) while application projects use the unversioned aliases, matching Apple's SDK expectations.
Native WASM builds for Emscripten versions targeting pre-.NET 8 runtimes have been removed, reducing package size and simplifying the WASM build matrix.
Bundled native libraries updated: HarfBuzz 14.2.0, FreeType 2.14.3, zlib 1.3.2.1-motley, libpng 1.6.58, libexpat 2.7.5, libjpeg-turbo 3.1.4.1, and expat 2.8.1.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Singleton lifecycle rework, variable font and HarfBuzzSharp support, SKPath finalizer fix, SKPaint text/font obsolete promotion, Android default-typeface resolution, generator toolchain update, and Uno sample maintenance.
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets support and C# 13 PolySharp support on legacy TFMs.
contributor_summaries.ebariche: Internal CI and build infrastructure improvements.
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: Fix for SKGLView not rendering after tab switch in MAUI TabBar on Android.

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Opened the v4 line on Skia m132/m133, introducing variable font support in both SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, Linux Bionic and Tizen x64/arm64 native assets, a fix for the Android MAUI TabBar rendering regression, and the first wave of v4 API modernisation.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Added animated WebP encoding (SKWebpEncoder), zero-copy stream-to-data conversion (SKStream.GetData), and reworked singleton instance lifecycle; fixed Apple platform TFMs, SKPath finalizer crash, and default-typeface resolution on Android.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Added color font palette support, the new HBColor struct, missing API wrappers, and SKSamplingOptions support for DrawSurface; refreshed freetype, zlib, libpng, libexpat, libjpeg-turbo, and harfbuzz native dependencies.
preview_summaries.v4.148.0-rc.1.2: Upgraded to Skia m148, corrected SKPixmap GetPixelSpan stride and offset bugs, promoted SKPaint text/font obsoletes and remaining pre-v4 APIs to compile errors, moved the native-compat gate off ModuleInitializer, and fixed WinUI Projection DLL loading on .NET 9.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.0 ships variable font axis support alongside the new HBColor struct for correct hb_color_t (BGRA) representation.
